tip.1: Super + Space opens the Omarchy menu.
tip.2: Super + Alt + Space opens the app grid.
tip.3: Super + Escape opens the system menu.
tip.5: Super + Alt + K shows the Tmux keybindings.
tip.7: Super + Alt + Return opens a Tmux terminal.
tip.8: Super + Shift + Return opens the browser.
tip.9: Super + Shift + Alt + B opens a private browser window.
tip.10: Super + Shift + F opens the file manager.
tip.11: Super + Shift + T opens the activity monitor.
tip.14: Super + Shift + Q opens the calculator.
tip.15: Super + W or Super + Q closes the window.
tip.16: Ctrl + Alt + Delete closes all windows.
tip.18: Super + Alt + F goes full width and keeps the top bar.
tip.19: Super + Ctrl + F fills the window without leaving the tiles.
tip.20: Super + T floats or tiles a window.
tip.21: Super + J flips windows between stacked and side by side.
tip.22: Super + O pops a window out so it floats across workspaces.
tip.23: Super + M minimizes a floating window.
tip.24: Double-click a floating window's titlebar to maximize it.
tip.25: Super + arrow keys move focus between windows.
tip.26: Super + Shift + arrow keys swap windows.
tip.27: Hold Super and drag with the left mouse button to move a window.
tip.28: Hold Super and drag with the right mouse button to resize a window.
tip.29: Super + Minus and Super + Equal resize a window sideways.
tip.30: Super + L cycles the workspace layout: dwindle, scrolling, floating.
tip.31: The shape by each workspace number shows its layout. Click it to cycle.
tip.32: Each workspace keeps its own layout, even after a restart.
tip.33: Super + a number switches to that workspace.
tip.34: Super + Shift + a number moves the window to that workspace.
tip.35: Super + Shift + Alt + a number moves the window there without following it.
tip.36: Super + Tab jumps to the next workspace.
tip.37: Super + Shift + Tab jumps to the previous workspace.
tip.38: Super + Ctrl + Tab returns to the workspace you were on.
tip.39: Super + scroll wheel scrolls through workspaces.
tip.40: Each monitor has its own workspaces, 1 to 10.
tip.41: Super + Shift + Ctrl + arrow keys move a window to another monitor.
tip.42: Super + Shift + Alt + arrow keys move a workspace to another monitor.
tip.44: Super + Alt + S sends a window to the scratchpad.
tip.46: Super + Shift + ` moves a window onto the Quake console.
tip.48: Super + Alt + G takes a window out of its group.
tip.49: Super + Alt + Tab cycles through a window group.
tip.51: Super + Ctrl + Z zooms in. Super + Ctrl + Alt + Z zooms back out.
tip.53: Floating workspaces show a dock. Right-click an app there to pin it.
tip.54: In a terminal, omarchy dock position left moves the dock.
tip.55: In a terminal, omarchy dock autohide on hides the dock until you need it.
tip.56: Super + Ctrl + T opens the theme picker.
tip.57: Super + Ctrl + W picks a background from the current theme.
tip.58: Omarchy ships with twenty-two themes. Find more at omarchy.org/themes.
tip.59: A theme restyles the desktop, terminal, Neovim, btop and Chromium together.
tip.60: Put your own backgrounds in ~/.config/omarchy/backgrounds/<theme name>.
tip.62: Super + Shift + Backspace toggles window gaps.
tip.63: Super + Shift + Space hides or shows the top bar.
tip.64: Drag an empty patch of the top bar toward a screen edge to move it.
tip.65: Double-click empty top bar space to cycle it between clear, glassy and opaque.
tip.66: In a terminal, omarchy bar position bottom moves the bar to the bottom.
tip.67: In a terminal, omarchy bar defaults resets the top bar.
tip.68: Right-click the Omarchy logo in the bar to open a new terminal.
tip.69: Click the clock for a calendar. Right-click it to change its format.
tip.70: Middle-click the clock to pick a timezone.
tip.71: Click the weather for a forecast. Middle-click it to refresh.
tip.72: Scroll over the audio icon to change the volume. Right-click it to mute.
tip.73: Scroll over the display icon to change the brightness.
tip.74: Right-click the power icon to show the battery percentage.
tip.75: The update badge only appears when an update is waiting. Click it to update.
tip.76: Super + Ctrl + A opens the audio panel.
tip.77: Super + Ctrl + N opens the network panel.
tip.78: Super + Ctrl + B opens the Bluetooth panel.
tip.79: Super + Ctrl + D opens the display panel.
tip.80: Super + Ctrl + P opens the power panel.
tip.81: Super + Ctrl + Alt + D opens the calendar.
tip.82: Super + Ctrl + Alt + E opens the world clock.
tip.83: Bar panels work from the keyboard: arrows move, Return activates, Escape closes.
tip.84: Super + Ctrl + S shares files with LocalSend.
tip.85: Super + Ctrl + H opens the hardware menu.
tip.86: Super + Ctrl + O opens the toggle menu.
tip.87: Super + Ctrl + L locks the screen.
tip.88: Super + Ctrl + I toggles locking when idle.
tip.89: Super + Ctrl + E opens the emoji picker.
tip.90: Super + C copies, Super + V pastes, Super + X cuts.
tip.91: Super + Ctrl + V opens the clipboard manager.
tip.93: No Print Screen key? Super + Ctrl + Alt + C takes a screenshot.
tip.94: Super + Ctrl + C opens the capture menu.
tip.95: Alt + Print Screen records the screen. Press it again to stop.
tip.96: Super + Print Screen picks a colour off the screen.
tip.97: Super + Ctrl + Print Screen copies text out of an image.
tip.98: Alt + Shift + L copies the URL of the current web app or page.
tip.99: Super + , acts on the latest notification.
tip.101: Super + Shift + Alt + , opens notification history.
tip.103: Super + Ctrl + R sets a reminder.
tip.104: Super + Ctrl + Alt + R shows all your reminders.
tip.105: Super + Ctrl + Alt + T shows the time as a notice.
tip.106: Super + Ctrl + Alt + B shows the battery level as a notice.
tip.107: Shift + Brightness Up jumps to full brightness.
tip.108: Alt + Volume Up or Down changes the volume in 1% steps.
tip.109: Shift + Mute switches to the next audio output.
tip.110: Alt + Play skips to the next track.
tip.111: Super + Shift + Ctrl + A picks your AI agent.
tip.114: Change the language under Setup > Language in the Omarchy menu.
tip.115: In the file manager, Ctrl + L jumps to a path and Space previews a file.
tip.116: In Tmux, the prefix is Ctrl + Space.
tip.117: In Neovim, Space Space opens a file by fuzzy search.
tip.118: Shift + CapsLock, then Space Space, types an em dash.
tip.119: In a terminal, omarchy update updates Omarchy and your packages.
tip.120: In a terminal, omarchy theme list shows your themes.
tip.121: In a terminal, omarchy theme set <name> applies a theme.
tip.122: In a terminal, omarchy font list shows the fonts you can use.
tip.123: In a terminal, omarchy font set <name> changes the system font.
tip.124: In a terminal, omarchy theme bg next cycles the background.
tip.125: In a terminal, omarchy plugin list shows your shell plugins.
tip.126: In a terminal, omarchy commands lists everything omarchy can do.
